mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_ai_search_failure_logs ( question, targets, intent_types, entity_ids, lexical_keywords, expanded_queries, failure_type, failure_stage, retryable, eval_candidate, qdrant_hit_count, vector_chunk_count, lexical_chunk_count, merged_count, ranked_count, intent_filtered_count, judge_candidate_count, judged_count, final_ground_count, result_msg, public_message, diagnostic_message ) VALUES ( #{failure.question}, #{failure.targets}, #{failure.intentTypes}, #{failure.entityIds}, #{failure.lexicalKeywords}, #{failure.expandedQueries}, #{failure.failureType}, #{failure.failureStage}, #{failure.retryable}, #{failure.evalCandidate}, #{failure.qdrantHitCount}, #{failure.vectorChunkCount}, #{failure.lexicalChunkCount}, #{failure.mergedCount}, #{failure.rankedCount}, #{failure.intentFilteredCount}, #{failure.judgeCandidateCount}, #{failure.judgedCount}, #{failure.finalGroundCount}, #{failure.resultMsg}, #{failure.publicMessage}, #{failure.diagnosticMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT( normalized_question, '|', COALESCE(targets, ''), '|', COALESCE(intent_types, ''), '|', COALESCE(entity_ids, ''), '|', failure_type, '|', failure_stage ) AS candidate_key, MAX(failure_id) AS latest_failure_id, MAX(question) AS sample_question, targets, intent_types, entity_ids, MAX(lexical_keywords) AS lexical_keywords, MAX(expanded_queries) AS expanded_queries, failure_type, failure_stage, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count, MIN(created_at) AS first_created_at, MAX(created_at) AS latest_created_at FROM ( SELECT failure_id, question, LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(question), ' ', ''), CHAR(9), ''), '?', ''), '？', '')) AS normalized_question, targets, intent_types, entity_ids, lexical_keywords, expanded_queries, failure_type, failure_stage, created_at FROM law_ai_search_failure_logs WHERE eval_candidate = 1 AND retryable = 1 AND review_status = 'OPEN' AND created_at >= #{since} ) recent_failures GROUP BY normalized_question, targets, intent_types, entity_ids, failure_type, failure_stage HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minOccurrences} ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, latest_created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT failure_id, question, targets, intent_types, entity_ids, lexical_keywords, expanded_queries, failure_type, failure_stage, retryable, eval_candidate, qdrant_hit_count, vector_chunk_count, lexical_chunk_count, merged_count, ranked_count, intent_filtered_count, judge_candidate_count, judged_count, final_ground_count, result_msg, public_message, diagnostic_message, review_status, promoted_eval_case_id, created_at FROM law_ai_search_failure_logs WHERE failure_id = #{failureId}
